content_fields.title: Secure daemon configuration files (Docker)
content_fields.description: Secure the Docker daemon configuration files on the container hosts.
content_fields.guidance: The daemon configuration, socket and certificate files should be owned by root, not writable by any other user, and audited for change, so nobody can alter daemon behaviour without detection.
content_fields.found: No daemon configuration file is present in the repository.
content_fields.missing: Filesystem access to the container hosts where those files live.
content_fields.conclusion: Daemon file permissions are host hardening, not a change in application source.
content_fields.action: The platform team should apply ownership and permission hardening to the daemon files.
